Textures in this folder: copied unmodified from OpenComputers 1.12.64-GTNH (the GT New Horizons fork,
OpenComputers-1.12.64-GTNH.jar in the GTNH 2.9.0-RC-2 pack; source https://github.com/GTNewHorizons/OpenComputers
at tag 1.12.64-GTNH), by Florian "Sangar" Nuecke and the OpenComputers contributors. The jar's LICENSE (beside this
file as LICENSE.txt) puts the code under the MIT License and all images and textures in the public domain (CC0 1.0).
